posts.title: How I built swath: listing a billion S3 objects in 4 minutes
posts.description: How I built swath to list unfamiliar, billion-object S3 buckets quickly, reliably, and with bounded memory.

posts.title: How intelligent is S3 Intelligent-Tiering?
posts.description: Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering is about as smart as it can be, given what S3 actually knows. With better context, it could often do a lot better.

posts.title: Buckets and objects are not enough
posts.description: S3 has buckets and objects, but no native concept of a dataset. A lot of cost and governance pain traces back to that gap.
